readerCopy.body: Honesty can cost far less affection than expected when a relationship has enough flexibility to hold a different preference or boundary. When Venus sextiles Lilith, connection and autonomy cooperate, making a changed term, style choice, money conversation, or direct desire easier to name without blowing up the bond. The flexibility provides information that pretending cannot. A relationship becomes more trustworthy when approval can survive a preference that was previously treated as too inconvenient to say plainly.
